overview: The commission reviewed and approved several corporate license amendments, change of manager applications, and seasonal one-day and farmer's market licenses. Commissioners also voted to establish an administrative approval process for outdoor dining alcohol service.

items.title: Housekeeping and Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes of the previous meeting.

items.title: 1359 Associates - Change of Manager
items.summary: Approved the application appointing John Malcolm as the new manager for 1359 Associates at 42 Alfred Street.

items.title: Semolina Kitchen - Stock Transfer and Change of Director
items.summary: Approved a revised application to the ABCC for stock transfer and the addition of Bruno de Oliveira Barbosa as a director and shareholder at 572 Boston Avenue.

items.title: Wegmans - Change of Officers
items.summary: Approved corporate officer updates for Wegmans' on-premises restaurant and package store licenses at 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway, pending submission of an amended page and updated compliance certificates.

items.title: Winter Hill Brewing Company - One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved seven one-day beer garden licenses at the Condon Shell across June, July, August, and October, contingent upon updated insurance documentation.

items.title: Medford Brewing Company - One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved one-day licenses for farmers market concerts and the jazz festival at Condon Shell, a community event at Dugger Park, Medford Pride Day at City Hall, and Circle the Square at 29 High Street.

items.title: House Bear Brewing - Farmers Market License
items.summary: Approved an application to sample and sell mead and cider for off-premises consumption at the Medford Farmers Market at the Condon Shell.

items.title: Stormalong Cider - Farmers Market License
items.summary: Approved a farmer-winery license to sample and sell hard cider for off-premises consumption at the Medford Farmers Market from June 13 through October 31.

items.title: Feast of the Republic Italian Festival - One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day wine and malt license for Mystic Dining LLC to serve alcohol in a cordoned section at the Condon Shell during the June 2 Italian festival, contingent on insurance submission.

items.title: Outdoor Dining Alcohol Licensing Policy
items.summary: Voted to grant automatic administrative approval for annual outdoor alteration of premises licenses to applicants who submit the ABCC certification form and obtain Outdoor Dining Commission approval.

items.title: Discussion on Cordial Licenses and Application Procedures
items.summary: Commissioners discussed minimum seating requirements for beer, wine, and cordial licenses, and agreed to table proposed revisions to the one-day license application fee structure until June.
